answer_1.quote: Given an input image I, a textual question Q, and a VLM M vl , the model generates an answer A and a grounding map G.

answer_2.quote: We use the Mean Average Precision (mAP) metric for hallucination detection and plot the Precision-Recall Curve to evaluate the grounding aspect of GVQA.

answer_3.quote: Evaluation within this benchmark is conducted using GPT-3.5 prompting, which has demonstrated high reliability and validity.
